hypothesis: Four supervised shared-action models for fill probability, conditional win probability, positive payoff magnitude and negative payoff magnitude. Classifiers use log_loss, amount regressors squared_error; other v8 hyperparameters unchanged. Expected net=fill*(win*gain-(1-win)*loss). May improve regime robustness over direct noisy net regression; it does not guarantee calibrated probabilities.
policy: Same730-day trailing fit window,8-day matured-label embargo, unchanged candidate geometry/frequency/1x and thresholds. No optimization on fold outcomes, no leverage increase.
advance_rule: Same v8 screen: positive normal and both stresses in at least6of8 folds, every scenario foldDD<=20%, >=30 fills and higher mean fold net than candidate-mean control. Neither passing nor choosing architecture on these dates creates independent evidence.
data_status: All evaluation dates already development. This is another disclosed research trial after v8 failed, no fresh test and no live approval.
